verdict.rationale: RDAP data confirms Namecheap applies WHOIS privacy redaction ("Privacy service provided by WITHHELD FOR PRIVACY LLC") on a queried domain, showing the mechanism exists and is active, but there is no evidence in the pack confirming it is free, on by default for all customers, or free of any upsell flow. Missing for 10: pricing/plan documentation stating privacy is free and default, absence-of-upsell confirmation, and independent user corroboration of no upsell during registration.
